title: Print anything, any number of things
description:
Write `std::string joined(const Ts&... values)` that returns all its arguments written out and separated by single spaces: `joined(1, "two", 3.5)` is `"1 two 3.5"`.

Stream each value into a `std::ostringstream`. Folding over the **comma operator** runs a statement once per argument:

```cpp
((out << values << ' '), ...);
```

That leaves a trailing space, which you will need to deal with. With no arguments, return an empty string.
hints: Fold over the comma operator to stream every value with a space after it, then take the string out of the stream.
Remove the trailing space before returning: if the string is not empty, `pop_back()`.
